def transform(grid):
    """Turn equal-colored marked lattice junction blocks into a compact grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if 9 not in grid[r]]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(h))]
    if len(rs) < 2 or len(cs) < 2:
        return []
    # Lattice baseline is the most common color on separator segments away from crossings.
    sep = [grid[r][c] for r in rs for c in range(w) if c not in cs]
    sep += [grid[r][c] for c in cs for r in range(h) if r not in rs]
    counts = {}
    for v in sep:
        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    base = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rs) for j, c in enumerate(cs)
              if grid[r][c] != base]
    if not points:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(i for i, j in points), max(i for i, j in points)
    c0, c1 = min(j for i, j in points), max(j for i, j in points)
    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            a, b = grid[rs[i]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i]][cs[j+1]]
            c, d = grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j]], grid[rs[i+1]][cs[j+1]]
            row.append(a if a == b == c == d and a != base else 9)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
